brent.proxy: Direct crude benchmark — used as a proxy for naphtha/benzene/olefins/HDPE/base oil and several specialty intermediates, since no free regional index exists for those specific commodities

elec-cn.proxy: Used as a proxy for chlor-alkali (caustic soda/chlorine) cost, since electricity is the dominant real input

elec-eu.proxy: Used as a proxy for chlor-alkali cost

elec-in.proxy: Used as a proxy for chlor-alkali cost

lci-apac.proxy: Blended regional proxy, not a single official series

lci-mea.agency: WTW Africa salary survey + Gulf salary guides

sulfuric-acid-na.proxy: Used as a directional fallback for EU/Asia regions — no defensible regional proxy exists for sulfuric acid (byproduct-of-smelting relationship too indirect)

ethylene-propylene-na.proxy: Used as a proxy for olefins in India/MEA/APAC regions

water-eu.agency: Unverified — no source documented in file

ttf-eu.proxy: Used as a proxy for EU ammonia cost, since gas is 50-80% of Haber-Bosch cash cost

synthetic-rubber.agency: Unverified — flagged in project history as a mislabeled series name
synthetic-rubber.proxy: Used as a proxy for styrene/butadiene — tracks synthetic rubber, not styrene directly; a known, uncorrected labeling issue

corn.proxy: Used as a proxy for gluconic acid pricing

iron-scrap-na.proxy: Used as a directional fallback for all non-US regions

benzene-na.proxy: Bundled with toluene/xylene, not benzene alone

gas-india.proxy: Used as a proxy for India ammonia cost

gas-mea.proxy: Used as a proxy for MEA ammonia cost

lab-apac.agency: ICIS (directional commentary only — subscription required for full data)

coal-au.agency: World Bank Pink Sheet (Australia thermal coal)

guar-gum.agency: Unverified — no source documented in file

base-oil-na.agency: US BLS PPI (does not distinguish Group I/II/III)

orange-gl.agency: Unverified — no source documented in file

hides-gl.agency: Unverified — no source documented in file

sulfuric-acid-cn.proxy: Real China series (May 13 2026: 1,862.50 RMB/ton, +120% YTD, driven by China's own May 1 2026 sulfuric acid export ban plus sulfur cost inflation). Forecast reflects a partial, slow easing to a new elevated normal, not a full reversion, since the export ban is an ongoing policy action.

caustic-soda-cn.proxy: Real China series (current ~867-871 RMB/ton; FOB export price move from $330 to $480/ton documented amid the 2026 Iran war, already partially eased per SunSirs' own reporting).
